name: mcp__paseo__browser_close_tab
description:
Close a Paseo browser tab, remove its resident webview, and unregister it from the browser automation host. Use browserId from browser_new_tab or browser_list_tabs.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__paseo__browser_close_tab(args: { browserId: string; }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```

name: mcp__paseo__browser_evaluate
description:
Evaluate a JavaScript function in a Paseo browser tab. Use browserId from browser_new_tab or browser_list_tabs; when ref is provided, refs come from the latest browser_snapshot and the resolved element is passed as the first argument.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__paseo__browser_evaluate(args: { browserId: string; function: string; ref?: string; }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```

name: mcp__paseo__browser_list_tabs
description:
List open Paseo browser tabs for this agent's workspace across connected browser automation hosts. Use returned browserId values with tab-scoped tools.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__paseo__browser_list_tabs(args: { [key: string]: unknown; }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```

name: mcp__paseo__browser_logs
description:
Read recent console messages and browser performance network entries for a Paseo browser tab. Use browserId from browser_new_tab or browser_list_tabs; maxEntries defaults to 50.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__paseo__browser_logs(args: { browserId: string; maxEntries?: number; }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```

name: mcp__paseo__browser_new_tab
description:
Create a new Paseo browser tab in this agent's workspace on the most recently connected browser automation host, opened in the background without switching the user's view. Pass an http(s) URL or a scheme-less host URL, which is treated as http; the returned browserId is used by tab-scoped tools.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__paseo__browser_new_tab(args: { url?: string; }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```

name: mcp__paseo__browser_screenshot
description:
Capture a PNG screenshot of a Paseo browser tab. Use browserId from browser_new_tab or browser_list_tabs. Set fullPage to true to capture the full page.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__paseo__browser_screenshot(args: { browserId: string; fullPage?: boolean; }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```

name: mcp__paseo__browser_snapshot
description:
Return a model-readable snapshot of a Paseo browser tab. Use browserId from browser_new_tab or browser_list_tabs; refs come from the latest browser_snapshot of the same tab and expire when the page changes.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__paseo__browser_snapshot(args: { browserId: string; }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```

name: mcp__paseo__capture_terminal
description:
Capture plain-text terminal output lines from a terminal session.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__paseo__capture_terminal(args: { end?: number; scrollback?: boolean; start?: number; stripAnsi?: boolean; terminalId: string; }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```

name: mcp__paseo__list_terminals
mcp__paseo__list_workspaces
mcp__paseo__send_terminal_keys
description:
Send text or a key token: Enter, Tab, Escape, Space, BSpace, Up, Down, Left, Right, Home, End, Insert, Delete, PageUp, PageDown, or F1-F12. Combine C- (Ctrl), M- (Alt), and S- (Shift) prefixes, e.g. C-r, S-Tab, or C-M-Left. Set literal=true to send the text unchanged.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__paseo__send_terminal_keys(args: { keys: string; literal?: boolean; terminalId: string; }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```
